title: Ship built-in curated material catalog
user_summary: Bundle the 798 approved knowledge cards as a sanitized seed and import them safely on first launch or upgrade.
technical_summary: Export the approved 780 isolated and 18 native derived cards into a Pydantic-validated source-independent JSON asset; package it with the sidecar; atomically merge it at startup under an owned batch while preserving user rows and skipping equivalent content.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh database contains exactly 798 built-in cards after startup.
Repeated startup is idempotent and user-imported material is not overwritten or duplicated.
The release asset contains no source excerpts, local paths, API credentials, license secrets, or private keys.

data_compatibility.notes: No schema change. Adds an owned derived-data batch; existing books, analysis results and user materials are preserved.
